Relics are permanent items that give a passive bonus for the duration of the run. Most relics can be obtained regardless of the character you are playing. Each character has 9 Relics that can only be obtained by them.

Starter Relics are given to each character when beginning a run. This starter relic can later be replaced with an  {{QueryLink2|Relics|rarity:Ancient|upgraded version}} by picking up the {{R2|Touch of Orobas}} from the {{2|Ancient}} {{KW2|Orobas}} at the start of {{2|Acts#Act 2|Act 2}}, when offered.

== Obtaining Relics ==
* '''Relics''' can be obtained from a variety of sources including {{2|Elites}}, {{2|Map_Locations#Treasure_Room|Treasure Rooms}}, the {{2|Merchant}}, or using the {{R2|Shovel}} at {{2|Rest Sites}}.
* {{QueryLink2|Relics|rarity:Ancient|Ancient Relics}} are only offered by {{2|Ancients}} at the beginning of each {{2|Act}}.
* {{QueryLink2|Relics|rarity:Shop|Shop Relics}} are only obtainable from the {{2|Merchant}}. The third slot in the Merchant's relic offers is always stocked with a {{QueryLink2|Relics|rarity:Shop|Shop Relic}}. There are 30 shop relics. Each character has 1 shop relic that is exclusive to them.
* {{QueryLink2|Relics|rarity:Event|Event Relics}} are obtained through {{2|Events}} and cannot be obtained by any other means.
* {{QueryLink2|Relics|rarity:Special|Special Relics}} '''only''' include the {{R2|Circlet}} which is obtained by collecting or encountering every other relic available in a run. (Relics can only be encountered once in a run)

== Spawn Restrictions ==
* {{R2|Juzu Bracelet}} will not spawn when using the {{2|Custom Mode}} modifier {{KW2|Deadly Events}}.
* Character-specific relics cannot spawn in {{2|Map_Locations#Treasure_Room|Treasure Rooms}} due to how they work in {{2|Multiplayer}}. Because each player can choose which relic they want, character-specific relics are excluded so players playing other characters cannot take them.<ref>https://youtu.be/GEo7bEAIpds</ref>
* Relics can only be encountered once in a run, except for in the case that you skip a relic at a {{2|Map_Locations#Treasure_Room|Treasure Rooms}}, in which case the relic is ''not'' removed from the pool, and can be encountered later.<ref>https://youtu.be/PPHPQAXBPZQ</ref>
* The game checks whether or not the player has reached the Act 3 {{2|Map_Locations#Treasure_Room|Treasure Chest}} on floor 41 (38 in {{2|Multiplayer}} since each Act is one floor shorter there). This is to prevent certain relics that give some value over the course of a run from appearing at the Act 3 chest or later floors. Note that {{R2|Golden Compass}} increases the length of {{2|Acts#Act 2|Act 2}} by 2 floors, meaning this check erroneously stops the relics from spawning 2 floors too early. The following relics are all relics with that spawn restriction: 
** {{R2|Amethyst Aubergine}}
** {{R2|Book of Five Rings}}
** {{R2|Bowler Hat}}
** {{R2|Dragon Fruit}}
** {{R2|Frozen Egg}}
** {{R2|Girya}}
** {{R2|Juzu Bracelet}}
** {{R2|Lasting Candy}}
** {{R2|Lucky Fysh}}
** {{R2|Meal Ticket}}
** {{R2|Molten Egg}}
** {{R2|Old Coin}}
** {{R2|Planisphere}}
** {{R2|Shovel}}
** {{R2|Toxic Egg}}
** {{R2|White Beast Statue}}
** {{R2|White Star}}
